author: Seung Wook
problem: Takahashi picks an integer from A to B, then Aoki, knowing it, picks one from C to D; Aoki wins if the sum is prime, otherwise Takahashi wins. Read A B C D (each at most 100) and print the winner, Takahashi or Aoki, assuming both play optimally.
bug_description: The prime table only goes up to 100, but sums can reach 200, so primes like 101 or 103 are missed and Takahashi is wrongly declared the winner.

comments.accurate: Takahashi wins if some choice of his leaves Aoki no prime sum, using a precomputed table of primes
comments.wrong_behavior: Takahashi wins if some choice of his leaves Aoki no prime sum, checked against the primes up to 100
comments.wrong_location: Prime table verified; check the early exit in the inner loop over Aoki's choices
